verdict.rationale: OpenClaw provides mechanisms for bulk/parallel operations via subagents and swarm orchestration (Promise.all-style fan-out, bounded fan-out, structured results) and scripted automation (cron jobs, exec scripting), which enable bulk operations across many items programmatically. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated bulk-operations UI/API for batch-processing many discrete items (e.g., bulk skill installs, bulk message actions) — it's more of a general concurrency/orchestration primitive than a purpose-built bulk-ops feature, and no independent hands-on evidence confirms this at scale. missing for 10: dedicated bulk-item operation APIs/UI, hands-on independent validation of large-scale fan-out reliability, and explicit bulk examples beyond generic swarm/subagent docs.
